content: The test image shows a soybean stem with dark black/mottled streaking and what appears to be white cottony fungal growth on the stem and pods. The test image shows irregular coarse black blotching on the stem, with dried tan pods, consistent with late-season Anthracnose (Colletotrichum truncatum) on soybean.

- **Dried tan/straw pods**: consistent with late-stage Anthracnose
- **White cottony-like material**: minor, could be weathering; White Mold reference shows more prominent white mycelium
- **Overall plant appearance** (top panels of Anthracnose reference with golden dried stems/pods) matches test image well
